_comment: WS1 Session M — the onnxruntime C runtime the bundled FA path loads. This file is the COMMITTED source of truth for which runtime the app ships; the .dylib itself is gitignored (39 MB, platform-specific) and re-provisioned from README.md. The guard test scripts/onnxruntimeBundle.guard.test.ts asserts (a) apiVersion here == the ORT_API_VERSION the pinned `ort` in Cargo.toml computes, and (b) minorVersion >= apiVersion, so a future `ort` bump that raises the required C-API version fails loudly here instead of silently at runtime.
apiVersionRationale: With no `api-NN` feature enabled, ort-sys rc.13's version.rs computes ORT_API_VERSION = 17 (the floor). onnxruntime's C API is backward-compatible, so any runtime whose minor version is >= 17 satisfies it; 1.23.2 (minor 23) is the newest osx-x86_64 build published and comfortably clears the floor.
